title: Skills
subtitle: Instructions your agents load per stage. Your workspace's skills are yours to edit; the Thulu ones ship with the install.

empty.select: Pick a skill to see its files.

system_note: Thulu maintains this skill and every run gets it. Workspaces can read it but not change it.
system_note_mcp: Thulu maintains this skill. Every run with the {mcp} MCP wired gets it, without a grant. Workspaces can read it but not change it.
system_toggle_note: A workspace admin can turn it off for one agent on one stage, in the Skills tab of the agent in /agents/.

files.extra_note: Runs get prompt.md in full. Every other file (references/, templates) goes to the model as a list of paths, and it opens the one the instructions point to.

modal.title: New skill
modal.name: Name
modal.description_placeholder: What the agent learns from it

confirm.discard: Your edits to this file will be lost.
confirm.delete_file_message: The file leaves the skill. Its history stays, so you can restore it.

deleted.note: The files are gone; their history is kept. Restore brings back every file the skill had when it was deleted; grants removed with it stay removed.

meta.description_hint: the model reads only this before it decides to open the skill. Say when to use it.
meta.enforcement_hint: "When the model needs it": with Claude Code the model sees the name and the description and opens the skill if it applies; other engines get the whole text in the prompt. "Always in the prompt": the whole text goes into every run, with any engine.

usage.title: Used by
usage.load_failed: Could not load the agents that use it.

delete_modal.revoke: Remove it from these agents too
delete_modal.revoke_hint: Left in place, the grants hand any skill created later with this name to these agents.
delete_modal.history_hint: The history stays: you can restore the skill from the Deleted group.
